The Opportunity : The Room Attendant is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, order, and overall presentation of guest rooms, suites, and associated areas at the country club. This role ensures that all accommodations meet the clubâs high standards of comfort and hygiene, contributing directly to an outstanding member and guest experience. Duties And Functions Clean and reset guest rooms and suites, including dusting, vacuuming, making beds, and replenishing amenities. Clean and disinfect bathrooms, including sinks, toilets, showers, and mirrors. Replace used towels and linens with fresh, clean items. Report any maintenance issues, damages, or missing items to the supervisor promptly. Ensure guest rooms are stocked with proper supplies, such as toiletries, water, and club literature.
